About Piara Salt

From Mine to Market Since 1983

A family-owned Pakistani company specializing in Himalayan pink salt mining, processing, manufacturing and bulk supply.

Who We Are

Pakistan's Himalayan Salt Specialists

Pakistan is the authentic source of Himalayan pink salt, and Piara Salt has been mining, processing and manufacturing it for over four decades. Our high production capacity and bulk packaging options support every wholesale need, while our integrated private-label solutions let businesses customize products and packaging for their target markets.

Our facility is allergen-controlled and gluten-free and nut-free - a strong fit for brands that require a high level of allergen control - with EDI-compatible order processing for simple record keeping and on-time delivery.

Our Story

Four Decades of Salt

1983

The family business begins

Piara Salt starts its Himalayan salt journey in Pakistan - a family-owned company built on mining heritage and trust.

The Mines

Direct access to the Salt Range

Our own mining operations in the Salt Range of Punjab give every product a traceable route from rock to retail pack.

90+ Countries

A global export house

Today Piara Salt supplies Himalayan salt products to more than 90 countries across six continents.

600+ Brands

Private label at scale

More than 600 businesses have launched or expanded their own Himalayan pink salt brands with our private labeling facility.

Beyond Edible Salt

The Wider Himalayan Range

Private label options extend beyond edible salt - grow your brand into lamps and animal nutrition with the same partner.

Edible Salt

Fine and coarse Himalayan pink salt for retail, food service and private label brands.

Salt Lamps

Natural, shaped and basket-design Himalayan salt lamps for wellness and home ranges.

Animal Lick Salt

Natural rock salt lumps and compressed blocks for livestock nutrition.

Piara Salt is involved in the mining and manufacturing of Himalayan salt products and supplying to over 90+ countries - private-labeled for 600+ businesses since 1983.
